# Conventional Commit

Analyze the current git changes and generate a well-formed commit message following the [Conventional Commits specification](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).

## Workflow

### 1. Inspect changes

```bash
git status
git diff --cached    # staged changes
git diff             # unstaged changes
```

### 2. Determine the commit type and scope

**Types:**

| Type | When to use |
|------|-------------|
| `feat` | New feature or behavior visible to users/operators |
| `fix` | Bug fix |
| `docs` | Documentation only changes |
| `refactor` | Code restructuring without behavior change |
| `perf` | Performance improvement |
| `test` | Adding or correcting tests |
| `build` | Build system, Cargo.toml, Nix, CI changes |
| `ci` | CI workflow changes (`.github/workflows/`) |
| `chore` | Maintenance tasks (deps, lockfiles, toolchain) |
| `security` | Security hardening or vulnerability fix |

**Scope** (optional but recommended for this repo):

| Changed area | Scope |
|------|-------|
| `crate/server/src/core/operations/` | `kmip` |
| `crate/server/src/routes/` | `api` |
| `crate/server/src/config/` | `config` |
| `crate/server_database/` | `db` |
| `crate/crypto/` | `crypto` |
| `crate/clients/clap/` or `crate/clients/ckms/` | `cli` |
| `crate/clients/wasm/` | `wasm` |
| `ui/` | `ui` |
| `crate/hsm/` | `hsm` |
| `documentation/` or `cli_documentation/` | `docs` |
| `.github/workflows/` | `ci` |
| `nix/` | `nix` |
| `test_data/` or `crate/test_kms_server/` | `test` |

### 3. Construct the commit message

```text
type(scope): imperative description (max 72 chars)

[optional body: more detailed explanation, WHY not WHAT]

[optional footer: BREAKING CHANGE: ..., Closes #N]
```

### 4. Stage and commit

```bash
git add <files>
git commit -m "type(scope): description"
```

## Pre-commit Hook Reminder

This repo enforces conventional commits via pre-commit hooks. Make sure hooks are installed:

```bash
pip install pre-commit conventional-pre-commit
pre-commit install
pre-commit install --install-hooks -t commit-msg
```

**Never bypass hooks** with `git commit --no-verify` or `SKIP=...`. Fix the error instead.

## CHANGELOG Note

- The **root `CHANGELOG.md` is generated by `git-cliff` from commit messages — never edit it manually.**
- Branch-specific changelogs live in `CHANGELOG/<branch-name>.md` — use `/kms-changelog` to create the entry.
- Breaking changes in the commit footer automatically appear as breaking change entries in the generated CHANGELOG.

## Examples

```text
feat(kmip): add KMIP 2.1 Encrypt operation with AES-GCM support

fix(api): return 403 instead of 500 when object access is denied

refactor(db): extract retry logic into shared helper

feat(cli)!: rename --sqlite-path flag to --sqlite-data-path

BREAKING CHANGE: operators must update their kms.toml and startup scripts
Closes #42
```
